## Project Overview
Costa Furtune is a 4.5-acre integrated sovereign master township developed across three distinct, ORERA-registered phases anchored by a shared luxury vertical clubhouse:

### Phase 1: Costa Fortune Triplex (Delivered & Handed Over)
- Concept: G+2 Sovereign Luxury Villas
- Status: 100% Completed, Handed Over & Occupied
- ORERA Registration: RP/19/2023/00854
- Resale & Promoter Registry: Available directly via developer desk

### Phase 2: Costa Furtune Crestview (Active Flagship Construction)
- Structure: B + S + 12 High-Rise Superstructure
- Total Residences: 144 Premier 3 BHK Homes + 2 Convenient Retail Frontages
- Unit Sizes: 1,845 sq ft, 1,941 sq ft, 2,013 sq ft, and 2,033 sq ft
- Pricing: From ₹5,700/sq ft (₹1.05 Cr to ₹1.16 Cr)
- ORERA Registration: MP/19/2024/01244
- Sanction Authority: Bhubaneswar Development Authority (BDA)
- Committed Possession Date: August 19, 2028
- Construction Technology: Monolithic RCC earthquake-resistant frame, AAC blocks

### Phase 3: Costa Furtune Horizon Heights (Twin Towers & Duplex Penthouses)
- Structure: Twin B + S + 12 Towers with Duplex Penthouses & Commercial Spine
- ORERA Registration: RP/19/2026/01487
- Location: Direct 200 ft NH Bypass frontage
- Committed Possession: June 2029

### Amenity Anchor: Club Costa Fantacy
- Structure: G + 3 Vertical Clubhouse with 4th-Floor Open-to-Sky Party Terrace
- Status: Clubhouse superstructure completed & construction-ready
- Highlights: Semi-covered infinity lap pool, toddlers splash deck, fully equipped multi-gym, grand banquet hall, billiards & indoor games, bridal suite, catering kitchen, cafe, unisex grooming salon, on-site pharmacy, and 24/7 ATM kiosk.
